Name: Roses in the Sand - Anthro Characters Continued Patch
Author: Kjorteo
Description:
[b][u][size=5]About[/size][/u][/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url]﻿ is a lovely conversion mod for the entire cast of Stardew Valley vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded.  It transforms Sandy into an absolutely stunning moth.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30976]Roses in the Sand[/url]﻿ is an equally lovely Sandy expansion mod that gives her more of a backstory, more heart events, and the ability to romance her.

Of course, that means that Roses in the Sand adds a significant amount of new sprites and portraits for moods, situations, and scenes that were not covered in Anthro Characters Continued.

Enter this mod: This is a simple asset replacement mod to convert Roses in the Sand's Sandy sprite and portrait sheets into her moth form, matching and compatible with Anthro Characters Continued.

[b][u][size=5]Installation[/size][/u][/b]

This package has been coded and put together as its own Content Patcher mod.  You should be able to add it in non-destructively--that is, without having to overwrite any assets inside the ACC or RitS folders.

To install:

[list=1]
[*]Download and extract the contents of this mod to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[/list]
... That's honestly it.

[b][u][size=5]Verifying the Installation[/size][/u][/b]

If you want to check and make sure that it worked and that the mod is properly installed and running, access your mod settings through Generic Mod Config Menu.  If you see a header and options for "Roses in the Sand (ACC Patch)" then it's installed.

If you really want to make sure, go to the config settings and change either the Sprites, Portraits, or both to the option called "Test."  These options are designed to replace Sandy's sprites and portraits (respectively) with a loud purple checkerboard pattern within a black silhouette.  They look a bit... out of place for an actual play-through, but that's the idea; they're there so you have an immediately visually obvious tell.  Unsure whether this mod is doing anything?  Turn Sandy's Test sprites or portraits on while she's around.  [i][b]You'll know.[/b][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/38eqHjq.png[/img]

If she looks like [i]that,[/i] then you're all set.  Enjoy the game!  (Maybe change her back, first, though.)

[b][u][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]

This mod has special optional manifest dependency declarations for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22271]Furry Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking For Love Redux[/url], which has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16300]its own Anthro Characters Continued patch[/url] which we highly recommend. This means that if this mod notices you have any of these other mods installed, it will make them dependencies, meaning it will load after them and thus work properly alongside them.  If you do [i]not[/i] have these mods installed, this mod simply ignores them and carries on, so it should work either way.

That said, if you're running Looking For Love Redux, you might want to turn off/leave blank all the sprite and portrait options for Sandy, just in case.  (You might want to turn off the ability to date her in LFLR if you're running Roses in the Sand, too, just so the two different sets of extra Sandy romance events don't collide with each other.)

Everyone included in LFLR besides Sandy should be completely unaffected and okay to proceed with as normal.

This mod literally just gives Sandy new sprites and portraits; it will probably clash with anything else that also gives Sandy new sprites and portraits and be perfectly compatible with anything that doesn't.  It does have separate options to enable/disable the sprites and the portraits, though, if you want to mix and match.

[b][u][size=5]Roadmap[/size][/u][/b]

This mod is currently somewhat lacking in features.  Worry not; we're just getting started!  As of this writing, we kind of just wanted to get this thing out there.  More features will almost definitely be coming in future updates.

Tentative to-do list:

[list]
[*][b][s]Improved base sprites:[/s][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3584]Done as of 1.1.0![/url]﻿
[*][b]Special outfits:[/b] Yes, I know.  Roses in the Sand has unique Sandy outfits for every season plus two more just for certain single-day festivals.  This mod currently has one (1) standard outfit.  There's a placeholder "Special Outfits" setting in its configuration options, but said setting literally does nothing as of this writing.  Obviously, the plan is to finish converting the rest of those outfits and add them in as soon as we're able.
[*][b]New standard outfit:[/b] Currently, Sandy's seasonal outfit for Winter is the same as her standard 24/7 outfit when you have the Special Outfits setting disabled.  (This isn't just because we haven't implemented the rest of the outfits, yet; Roses in the Sand itself does this, too.)  Maybe that's fine?  Maybe there doesn't need to be a whole new outfit just to be an alternate standard for when you don't have special outfits enabled, especially because that means people who do run special outfits ironically would never see it.  Or... maybe I already have some ideas for a new standard outfit and some ideas for how to sneak it with the special outfits as well....
[/list]
Keep an eye on this mod, or at least update it whenever SMAPI tells you there's a new version.  Hopefully you'll stick with us as it continues to grow!
